name: 6830-chat-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB. Read off config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 320 requests / 2400 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/sharegpt-320-llama3.jsonl` -- 320 real ShareGPT conversations, first human turn as the prompt, each row served exactly once; output length is taken from the row and enforced with `ignore_eos`, sampling is greedy (temperature 0.0). Prompt tokens mean 204.9 (max 933), output tokens mean 215.3 (max 780), 68889 output tokens over the file; the chat template adds exactly 10 tokens per row, so the longest wire sequence is 1580.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on an 8B model, answering one short conversational turn at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit b3856bef7df6e2f86e54a766eb83b4d77f98ee90 (v0.5.4-219).
# These are the arguments that engine accepts; do not add keys from a later vLLM, and check any
# edit against this commit's own venv (configs/env.yaml).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
use-v2-block-manager: true
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
